name: Sonasu
source:
One of the angels who carries out the "apocalypse."
The angel who carries out the final selection.
She is responsible for leading the angels of the "apocalypse," always calm and composed.
She is extremely loyal to rules and duties, and while communication is possible, mutual understanding is difficult.
Once she takes on her role as an angel of the "apocalypse," she will carry out her master's orders with flawless precision.
